name: Death Covens
source: Black Death City Playtest v1.03, pp.93-112 (printed page numbers)

strongholds.name: Opulent Manor
strongholds.text: Banquet of Blood: aftermath step 3, up to 3 Vampyres earn d6 bonus XP (2d6 if you won).

strongholds.name: Embalmer's Hall
strongholds.text: Necromantic Study: each aftermath pick one: Leader gains 5 bonus XP (step 3), or on a 5+ (step 6) recruit a Zombie for 0 silver.

strongholds.name: Grand Pavilion
strongholds.text: Bestial Trophies: each Beast taken down by your Leader that is killed gives the Leader 10 XP. A Howl in the Night: aftermath step 6, on a 6 recruit a Dire Wolf for 0 silver.

strongholds.name: Ancient Barrows
strongholds.text: Barrow Offering: aftermath step 5, on a 6 roll once on the treasure table. Immortal Slumber: if the Leader is Laid to Rest they miss d3 battles instead of being removed.

special_rules.name: Noble Blood
special_rules.text: When recruited, pick 1 skill.

special_rules.name: Spellcraft
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Blood. Pick 1 signature spell; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Master of Necromancy
special_rules.text: Knows the Lore of Necromancy. Pick 2 signature spells; prepare 1 random spell each battle.

special_rules.name: Noble Blood
special_rules.text: When recruited, pick 1 skill.

special_rules.name: Bestial Transformation
special_rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of its activation it can transform: replace it with the Lycanfell Beast at the same location (damage carries over). The Beast immediately makes its activation.

special_rules.name: Temperamental Transformation
special_rules.text: At the end of each of its activations it must pass a Willpower test else the transformation ends: replace it with the Lycanfell Noble (damage carries over; if that reduces the Noble to 0 it is taken down).

special_rules.name: Vestiges of the Noble
special_rules.text: Treated as a new fighter with none of the Noble's wargear, skills or injuries, and unaffected by spells on the Noble. It inherits scenario marks and held treasure. If taken down the Noble is also taken down (counts as 1 for flee tests). Bonus XP goes to the Noble.

special_rules.text: When recruited, pick 2 skills.

special_rules.name: Unshakeable
special_rules.text: Ignores the Fear special rule and all rules that would make it scatter.

special_rules.name: Bloodline Mutations
special_rules.text: When recruited, may pick 1: Bat Wings (+15s, gains Fly), Wulfen Legs (+10s, Move 7"), Hulking Form (+30s, Life 8).

special_rules.name: Sniff 'em Out
special_rules.text: Enemy fighters are not hidden while within 9" of this fighter.

special_rules.name: Trackers
special_rules.text: Campaign: re-roll the exploration roll if the search party includes a Dire Wolf.

special_rules.name: Vampyric Bite
special_rules.text: Each time an enemy suffers 1 or more damage from this fighter's melee attack, heal this fighter 1 life.

armour.name: Warded Robes
armour.text: Each time targeted by an enemy spell, roll a dice; on a 4+ the spell has no effect on this fighter.

armour.name: Full-Plate
armour.text: Cannot be equipped with two-handed ranged weapons, except a Brace of Pistols.

items.name: Ancient Banner
items.text: While on the battlefield you can re-roll flee tests. Re-roll Willpower tests for friendly fighters within 12" that can see this fighter.

items.name: Bestial Companion
items.text: Each melee attack, make 1 additional attack with this weapon.

items.name: Grimoire
items.text: Once per battle, after this fighter has made a casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

items.name: Spirit Guardian
items.text: Once per battle bonus action: until end of round ignore Rend on attacks targeting this fighter; each successful armour roll against a melee attack deals 1 damage to the attacker.

items.name: Winged Familiar
items.text: Once per battle bonus action: a visible enemy within 24" is harried until end of round; each Move or Action it makes requires a Willpower test or it is lost.

spells.name: Witchfire
spells.text: Place d3 witchfire tokens by the caster (max 3). Once per activation spend one for a bonus action: the closest visible enemy within 12" is hit with the attack.

spells.name: Ethereal Armour
spells.text: A visible friendly fighter within 6" improves Armour by 1 (max 2+) until end of round.

spells.name: Raise Zombie
spells.text: A summoned Zombie joins until taken down, set up within 3" of the caster, not engaged. Max 3 summoned fighters.

spells.name: Twilight Translocation
spells.text: Another visible friendly fighter within 6" is set up again within 15" of the caster, not engaged.

spells.name: Death Blast
spells.text: Blast template on a point within 12", scatters d6"; each fighter in it is hit.

spells.name: Balefire
spells.text: Place the flame template from the caster; each fighter in it is hit.

spells.name: Draw Blood
spells.text: The closest visible enemy within 9" suffers 1 damage and the caster heals 1.

spells.name: Cursed Blades
spells.text: A friendly fighter within 6": 1 melee weapon gains Arcane and Poison until end of round.

spells.name: Raise Skeleton
spells.text: A summoned Skeleton (Cuirass, Shield and a Club, Spear or Sword) joins until taken down, set up within 3" of the caster, not engaged. Max 3 summoned fighters.

spells.name: Recall
spells.text: A friendly Thrall on the battlefield is set up again within 3" of the caster, not engaged.

spells.name: Bat Scream
spells.text: Flame template from the caster: each fighter in it suffers 1 damage and must pass a Willpower test or be disorientated (-1 to Attack and Parry rolls) until end of round.

spells.name: Sanguine Spear
spells.text: A line 12" long and 1" wide from the caster: each visible enemy it passes through is hit; heal the caster 1 per point of damage dealt.

skills.eligible: Undead Aristocrat Leaders and Champions only

skills.name: Cloud of Bats
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action: set up again wholly within 9" horizontally, not engaged.

skills.name: Mesmeric Gaze
skills.text: Once per battle in a melee attack action it makes: both roll d6 + Willpower; if this fighter's total exceeds, the defender has -1 Attacks on melee weapons for the action (off-hand unaffected).

skills.name: Supernatural Healing
skills.text: Campaign: lasting injuries are always temporary; if killed, a Willpower test means it instead misses d3 battles.

skills.name: Leech Blood
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action: each enemy within 9" takes a Willpower test; each failure deals 1 damage to it and heals this fighter 1.

skills.name: Relentless Attacker
skills.text: -1 to parry rolls made against this fighter's attacks.

skills.eligible: Undead Skeleton Leaders and Champions only

skills.name: Death March
skills.text: Once per battle bonus action: until end of round, +2 Move for friendly Thralls beginning a move within 9".

skills.name: Rise Again
skills.text: First time taken down, mark its location; at the start of each later round roll a dice, on a 6 it returns as close as possible and heals d3. Once per battle.

skills.name: Dread Aura
skills.text: Causes fear: enemies starting activation engaged with it must pass a Willpower test or their activation ends (fear-causers ignore).

skills.name: Drag Down Into the Earth
skills.text: When taken down while engaged, one fighter engaged with it suffers d3 damage.

skills.name: Kingsguard
skills.text: Champion only. If an enemy finishes a charge engaged with your Leader and this fighter is not engaged, it may Charge that enemy; if it ends engaged, that enemy must target it with melee attack actions this activation.

thrall_injury_table.1: Laid to Rest: treat as killed.
